sentence: Krakowski et al. note that AI costs almost nothing to reproduce and that little stands in the way of copying it, so where AI substitutes a human capability, the RBV predicts that the advantage resting on that capability will erode
passage: [Krakowski et al. (2023), p. 1426] "When AI substitutes humans' cognitive capabilities, the RBV expects the advantage that these capabilities provided to erode (Peteraf & Bergen, 2003). This is because, as a technology resource, AI has close to zero marginal reproduction costs and few imitation barriers (Brynjolfsson & McAfee, 2014, p. 31)."

gemini.note: The sentence is an accurate paraphrase of the passage, correctly capturing the causal logic and the theoretical prediction made by the RBV.
